name: core-links-many
description: Links' many-valued links (D56): a link with many and a max holds a list of targets, in the order they were linked. link adds a target or pins again one it holds, unlink removes the one it names, a create gives a list, each target once, and a deleted target leaves the lists that hold it. A required one keeps at least one target. The table a file's Links v2 left is built again, its rows kept. What reads one target of a link, Reactions' rules among them, refuses a many-valued link; Rollups and revised read across the list.
